message.content:
Flounder is **not actually a flounder fish** in *The Little Mermaid*; he’s depicted as a **bright yellow tropical reef fish** with blue stripes.[2][4] The exact species is not officially confirmed, but the most common guesses are an **angelfish** or a **sergeant major**-type reef fish.[1][2][5]

If you want, I can also explain why the character was named “Flounder” even though he isn’t one.
